text: The purpose of this Motion is to have City Council appoint two new public members to fill the current vacancies on the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee. These vacancies are a result of the resignation of two Committee members. It is necessary to make these appointments prior to February 8, 2018 to ensure the Committee can continue to carry out its mandate for the remainder of the term and to ensure quorum is met.

City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Glen Hart and Michael Miceli to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee, for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018, and until successors are appointed.
